meta.subject: Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Science Standard Six Term III 2024 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from lesson text, activities, numerical tables, fact boxes, ICT, evaluation, HOTS and project work. Edition-specific wording is preserved and ambiguous printed matching is not treated as an answer key.
source_notes: Both uploaded Term III 2024 English and Tamil books were used.

Activity 2 prepares soap with water, coconut oil and sodium hydroxide, while the chapter recap states olive oil/animal fat with concentrated sodium hydroxide as soap raw materials. Questions preserve each statement in its own context.

The printed Evaluation matching section displays crossed/mismatched pairings (Soap–C6H5OH, Cement–CaSO4·2H2O, etc.). The bank does not reproduce those mismatches as correct answers; concepts are answered from the lesson text.
The chapter calls the two sides of detergent molecules water-loving and water-hating; source wording is retained without substituting outside terminology.
The HOTS vermicompost response is limited to the source-supported role of earthworms in converting organic waste to compost castings and improving soil/plant health.
